description: List the organization's client-connect links, newest first — one-time links a client can open, with no BulkPublish account, to connect their own platform account. Paged: returns { clientConnectLinks, page, limit, total }, 50 per page by default (max 100); `total` counts every link, so request the next page while page × limit < total. Pro and Business only: on the single-seat Free and Lifetime plans this answers 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with the plan and an upgrade hint. Use this when the user wants to see the client-connect links they have created and whether each has been used yet.
name: list_client_connect_links
title: List client connect links
